headline: Accepted a library strategic plan with edits; approved the October 8, 2026 meeting minutes.
summary: Staff described a new visitors code of conduct for the library, City Hall, and the Senior Center, which goes to City Council on November 16. Reports covered staffing, a $10,000 Foundation gift expected in January, and budget talks with the City.
decisions: Accepted the Library Board of Trustees strategic plan with edits, by unanimous vote.
Approved the minutes of the October 8, 2026 meeting, by unanimous vote.

decision_evidence.quote: Upon a motion made by Trustee Stacey Pape and seconded by Trustee Holly Painter, the Trustees voted unanimously to accept the Library Board of Trustees Strategic Plan as amended with edits.
Upon a motion made by Trustee Anne LaLonde and seconded by Trustee Marty Reid, the Trustees voted unanimously to accept the minutes of the October 8, 2026 Board of Trustees Meeting.
